svg.title: Left: cumulative net log return on the fresh planted-signal path for the primary crossover, the flat 0.5 meta filter, the probability-sized rule and the oracle filter, each scaled to the filter's volatility. Right: the Snippet 10.1 bet-size curves for two and three classes and the stepped two-class curve, over a histogram of the meta-model's out-of-fold probabilities.
